creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-29, 2026-11-22
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, custom template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 7) then animate_character v3 per direction. All four facings are separate PixelLab generations; nothing is mirrored. Directions were queued one to three at a time and appended to the same animation group because the account's 8 job slots were shared with other lanes.
prompt: Small chibi toad sitting on all fours, squat round body of dark warm grey-green skin with a lighter belly, big round eyes, wide mouth. Below its jaw hangs a large round glowing coal sac, a bright orange-red ember-coloured throat pouch clearly visible under the chin. Little warty bumps. 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: sits still breathing, the throat sac under the jaw swells and shrinks and glows slightly brighter, the eyes blink slowly

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, sits and breathes, the red coal sac under the jaw swells and shrinks, stays visible
direction_prompts.west: facing left, sits and breathes, the red coal sac under the jaw swells and shrinks, stays visible
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, sits and breathes, body rises and falls slightly
direction_prompts.east: facing right, sits and breathes, the red coal sac under the jaw swells and shrinks, stays visible

follow.action_description: hops forward in short heavy hops, landing with a squash; the red coal sac under the jaw stays visible and bounces

direction_prompts.south: hops toward the viewer in short compact hops, staying within a narrow column; the red coal sac under the jaw bounces and stays visible
direction_prompts.west: hops to the left in short hops; the red coal sac under the jaw stays visible
direction_prompts.north: hops away from the viewer, seen from behind, short compact hops
direction_prompts.east: hops to the right in short hops; the red coal sac under the jaw stays visible

attempts.what: character, then idle and follow v3, four directions each
